title: Add custom Instagram story images for travel style quiz results

requirements.text: Add image upload capability in the admin panel Travel Style Quiz section, allowing admins to upload one Instagram story base image per travel style archetype

quotes: ik wil ze uploaden in het admin panel bij de travel styles quiz
begin maar met per travel style 1 afbeelding

acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel includes upload interface in the Travel Style Quiz management section
Each travel style archetype (Thrill Seeker, Culture Connoisseur, Chill Escapist, etc.) has an upload field for one base image
Uploaded images are stored in the backend and associated with their respective travel style
Image upload supports common formats (JPG, PNG, WebP) with appropriate size validation

requirements.text: Generate Instagram story image by overlaying travel style name and description centered on the uploaded base image using Gotham Medium font when a user completes the travel style quiz

quotes: ik upload de image jij plaatst de tekst in Gotham medium er overheen wanneer de quiz is voldaan
Wanneer een gebruiker de quiz voltooit, plaats ik de travel style naam + beschrijving in Gotham Medium gecentreerd over de geüploade afbeelding

acceptanceCriteria: After quiz completion, the system retrieves the admin-uploaded base image for the user's primary travel style
Travel style name and description are rendered centered over the base image using Gotham Medium font
Text is properly positioned and styled for readability against the base image
Generated image maintains Instagram story dimensions (1080x1920)
If no custom image is uploaded for a travel style, fall back to default Instagram story generation

requirements.text: Display the generated Instagram story image in the first tile of the quiz results page, allowing users to download and share it on Instagram

quotes: De gegenereerde afbeelding verschijnt in de eerste tile van de quiz resultaten, waar gebruikers deze kunnen downloaden om te delen op Instagram
het mag gewoon in de eerste tile geplaatst worden

acceptanceCriteria: First tile in quiz results displays the generated Instagram story image with custom uploaded background
Users can download the generated image for sharing on Instagram
Download functionality works consistently across devices
Image quality is preserved during download

constraints: Use the existing instagramStoryGenerator.ts utility and extend it to support custom uploaded background images
Do not modify the quiz flow or question logic in TravelStyleQuiz.tsx
Maintain the existing travel style archetypes structure
Store uploaded images using the existing file storage registry pattern in backend/main.mo
nonGoals: Multiple image variants per travel style
Dynamic text positioning or custom text styling beyond Gotham Medium centered
Editing or removing the existing default Instagram story generation
Adding animation or interactive elements to the Instagram story image
Supporting Instagram story upload directly from the app
